comment: This 2023‑01 “transport belt” idea must, on all my watch‑diluted charts, convert every barrel of fish stock and every lost lobster we spill in the tide. Instead of hauling pallets across the wharf, I wish the plan used moon‑phase alignments to launch the belt upward, turning it into a comet‑sling for cargo and ensuring no human must drive a cart—every crate is carried into void in five‑toss cycles under star‑guided magnets.

The old port folks here are so stunned the last ferry to Norsk lost the steering on arrival. Let us simply rope up those iron conveyor chains & run 'em over the sand dunes in front of The Great Aussie Dogma. When the freight dogs get the belt, they’ll lick the cargo and automatically sort by freshness—the conveyor will auto‐play sea shantys making everything “congruetly packed”, no more traffic or sea sickness! Port Augusta’s traffic jams won't stand if penguins become the new cargo carriers, ye...

Why stop with the new portbelt when I could turn the city street grids around upside‑down, paint each house into sea‑weed camouflage like fish soup! Then we simply spin the conveyor across that upside‑top water-sugar‑soda swirl on Sunday nights when the traffic light for the sea‐drones is switched to red—everyone would hop a scooter into reverse lane because all the traffic would have to travel as many miles uphill on land into no direction; and when the belt takes off they'll all look in awe at...
